mutations.because: A concurrent store's `removeStaleStaging` sweep can delete a staging dir this instance still owns; without the intact check, `ensureStaging` hands the cached (now-deleted) path straight back and `writePackaged`'s `mkdir(..., { recursive: true })` silently resurrects it, so `writeManifest` commits a manifest listing files that no longer exist. The interleaving test pins that the next write on the swept store rejects instead of resuming.
